pattern: ^SELECT District, AVG\(Population\) as avg_[a-z]+ FROM city GROUP BY District .* WHERE city\.Population > district\_avg\.avg_[a-z]+ GROUP BY District$
correction: Calculate the average population of all cities first, then count the number of cities in each district that have a population greater than the average.

metadata.description: This rule corrects queries that incorrectly calculate an average for each district and then filter cities based on this calculated average.
